title: Structured AI for Startup Quality and Investor Readiness
subtitle: From manual reviews to scalable founder development
blurb: A full-stack AI product with structured founder journeys, LLM critique of pitch decks, iteration loops, and progression tracking, built on Next.js, Node, and PostgreSQL. From manual reviews to scalable founder development.
result: Manual reviews replaced with scalable, structured feedback
whoFor: Accelerators, incubators, and startup programs that review large volumes of founder pitch decks and progress but cannot scale one-on-one manual feedback to every founder.
challengeIntro: Reviewing pitch decks and founder progress well takes real expertise, and that expertise does not scale linearly. As the number of founders in a program grows, the quality and consistency of feedback each one receives tends to drop, and tracking who is actually improving becomes a spreadsheet exercise.
challengePoints: Manual deck review does not scale with the number of founders in a program.
Feedback quality varies depending on which reviewer a founder gets.
No structured way to track a founder's progression over multiple iterations.
Investor-readiness signals were judged informally, not measured consistently.
identifiedIntro: The underlying need was not an AI that reads decks. It was a structured journey: consistent critique, a way to iterate against that critique, and visibility into whether a founder was actually getting more investor-ready over time.
builtIntro: Covison built a full-stack AI product on Next.js, Node, and PostgreSQL, structured around:
builtPoints: Structured founder journeys from intake to readiness
LLM-based critique of pitch decks against consistent criteria
Iteration loops so founders could act on feedback and resubmit
Progression tracking across the whole cohort
whyNotOffTheShelf: Generic AI writing or deck tools give one-off feedback with no memory of a founder's history and no way to track improvement across a cohort. The value here was in the structure around the critique, not the critique alone.
productionReality: Deployed as the review layer for an active startup program.
Handles decks and progression tracking across a full cohort.
Built to be maintained and extended by the program, not a one-off script.
outcomeBullets: Manual, one-off reviews replaced with structured, repeatable feedback.
Founders get consistent critique regardless of who reviewed them before.
Progress toward investor readiness is now visible and trackable, not informal.
